Hi, I'm Qianrong Wu, and most people call me Q.

I'm a machine learning engineer at Roblox, working on problems at the intersection of machine learning, security, and large-scale systems.

## About this blog

This is where I write down what I'm learning and thinking about, mostly machine learning, AI, and systems. Writing helps me organize my thoughts and understand things better.

Corrections are always welcome — you can find me on [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/qianrongwu/).

Opinions here are my own.
